convert_detectron_resnet: convert detectron pretrained ResNet model to pytorch style checkpoint
convert_bn_layers: convert batch normalization layers from detectron caffe blobs to pytorch state dict format
convert_conv_fc_layers: convert convolutional and fully connected layers from detectron caffe blobs to pytorch state dict
run_convert_cli: run the detectron2pytorch CLI tool to convert a detectron ResNet-50 or ResNet-101 model
convert_resnet_checkpoint: convert a detectron caffe model checkpoint to a pytorch torch.save compatible state dict
